ABOUT KUPPAYAM 3.0

Winter Intensive Camp

New Skies · New Wings

This festive season, Markaz Knowledge City welcomes students to Winter Intensive Camp 2026 (Kuppayam 3.0) at WIRAS (World Institute for Research in Advanced Sciences). More than just a holiday camp, this three-day journey of learning, exploration, and inspiration is designed for young minds to discover their potential, broaden their perspectives, develop meaningful values, and build confidence for the future.

RECENT HIGHLIGHTS

Camp Stories

Markaz Knowledge City welcomes students to a vibrant three-day camp experience at WIRAS—combining Value-Based Living, Technology, Tilawat, Career Exploration, Mindscape Activities, and Educational Excursions.
